// 設定項目を属性で定義
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property)]
public class ConfigurationAttribute : Attribute
{
    public string Key { get; }
    public object DefaultValue { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public bool IsRequired { get; set; }
    public string Section { get; set; } = "General";

    public ConfigurationAttribute(string key)
    {
        Key = key;
    }
}

// 設定クラス
public class ApplicationSettings
{
    [Configuration("database.connectionString", IsRequired = true, 
                   Description = "データベース接続文字列")]
    public string DatabaseConnectionString { get; set; }

    [Configuration("api.timeout", DefaultValue = 30, 
                   Description = "API タイムアウト時間（秒）")]
    public int ApiTimeout { get; set; }

    [Configuration("logging.level", DefaultValue = "Info", Section = "Logging",
                   Description = "ログレベル")]
    public string LogLevel { get; set; }

    [Configuration("cache.expirationMinutes", DefaultValue = 60, Section = "Cache")]
    public int CacheExpirationMinutes { get; set; }

    [Configuration("features.enableNewUI", DefaultValue = false, Section = "Features")]
    public bool EnableNewUI { get; set; }
}

// 設定管理システム
public class ConfigurationManager
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, object> _configurationData;

    public ConfigurationManager(Dictionary<string, object> configurationData)
    {
        _configurationData = configurationData ?? new Dictionary<string, object>();
    }

    public T LoadConfiguration<T>() where T : new()
    {
        var instance = new T();
        var type = typeof(T);

        foreach (var property in type.GetProperties())
        {
            var configAttr = property.GetCustomAttribute<ConfigurationAttribute>();
            if (configAttr != null)
            {
                LoadPropertyValue(instance, property, configAttr);
            }
        }

        return instance;
    }

    private void LoadPropertyValue(object instance, PropertyInfo property, ConfigurationAttribute configAttr)
    {
        var key = configAttr.Key;

        if (_configurationData.TryGetValue(key, out var configValue))
        {
            try
            {
                var convertedValue = ConvertValue(configValue, property.PropertyType);
                property.SetValue(instance, convertedValue);
                Console.WriteLine($"設定読み込み: {key} = {convertedValue}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"設定変換エラー {key}: {ex.Message}");
                SetDefaultValue(instance, property, configAttr);
            }
        }
        else if (configAttr.IsRequired)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"必須設定項目が見つかりません: {key}");
        }
        else
        {
            SetDefaultValue(instance, property, configAttr);
        }
    }

    private void SetDefaultValue(object instance, PropertyInfo property, ConfigurationAttribute configAttr)
    {
        if (configAttr.DefaultValue != null)
        {
            try
            {
                var convertedDefault = ConvertValue(configAttr.DefaultValue, property.PropertyType);
                property.SetValue(instance, convertedDefault);
                Console.WriteLine($"デフォルト値設定: {configAttr.Key} = {convertedDefault}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"デフォルト値設定エラー {configAttr.Key}: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
    }

    private object ConvertValue(object value, Type targetType)
    {
        if (value == null) return null;
        if (targetType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType())) return value;

        // Nullable型の処理
        if (targetType.IsGenericType && targetType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
        {
            var underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(targetType);
            return ConvertValue(value, underlyingType);
        }

        // Enum型の処理
        if (targetType.IsEnum)
        {
            return Enum.Parse(targetType, value.ToString(), true);
        }

        // 基本的な型変換
        return Convert.ChangeType(value, targetType);
    }

    public void GenerateDocumentation<T>()
    {
        var type = typeof(T);
        Console.WriteLine($"\n=== {type.Name} 設定ドキュメント ===");

        var propertiesBySection = type.GetProperties()
            .Where(p => p.GetCustomAttribute<ConfigurationAttribute>() != null)
            .GroupBy(p => p.GetCustomAttribute<ConfigurationAttribute>().Section)
            .OrderBy(g => g.Key);

        foreach (var section in propertiesBySection)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"\n[{section.Key}]");

            foreach (var property in section.OrderBy(p => p.Name))
            {
                var configAttr = property.GetCustomAttribute<ConfigurationAttribute>();
                Console.WriteLine($"  {configAttr.Key}:");
                Console.WriteLine($"    型: {property.PropertyType.Name}");
                Console.WriteLine($"    必須: {(configAttr.IsRequired ? "はい" : "いいえ")}");

                if (configAttr.DefaultValue != null)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"    デフォルト値: {configAttr.DefaultValue}");
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(configAttr.Description))
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"    説明: {configAttr.Description}");
                }

                Console.WriteLine();
            }
        }
    }
}

// テーブルマッピング属性
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)]
public class TableAttribute : Attribute
{

// カラムマッピング属性
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property)]
public class ColumnAttribute : Attribute
{
    public string Name { get; }

    public bool IsIdentity { get; set; }
    public bool IsRequired { get; set; }
    public int MaxLength { get; set; }
    public string DataType { get; set; }

    public ColumnAttribute(string name = null)
    {
        Name = name;

// エンティティクラスの例
[Table("Employees")]
public class Employee
{
    [Column("Id", IsPrimaryKey = true, IsIdentity = true)]
    public int Id { get; set; }

    [Column("Name", IsRequired = true, MaxLength = 100)]
    public string Name { get; set; }

    [Column("Email", IsRequired = true, MaxLength = 255)]
    public string Email { get; set; }

    [Column("Department", MaxLength = 50)]
    public string Department { get; set; }

    [Column("Salary", DataType = "decimal(10,2)")]
    public decimal? Salary { get; set; }

    [Column("HireDate")]
    public DateTime HireDate { get; set; }

    // 計算プロパティ（DB列にマップされない）
    public int YearsOfService => DateTime.Now.Year - HireDate.Year;
}

// 簡易ORM実装
public class SimpleORM
{
    private readonly string _connectionString;

    public SimpleORM(string connectionString)
    {
        _connectionString = connectionString;
    }

    public string GenerateCreateTableSQL<T>()
    {
        var type = typeof(T);
        var tableAttr = type.GetCustomAttribute<TableAttribute>();

        if (tableAttr == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{type.Name}にTable属性が定義されていません");

        var tableName = $"{tableAttr.Schema}.{tableAttr.Name}";
        var columns = new List<string>();

        foreach (var property in type.GetProperties())
        {
            var columnAttr = property.GetCustomAttribute<ColumnAttribute>();
            if (columnAttr != null)
            {
                var columnDefinition = GenerateColumnDefinition(property, columnAttr);
                columns.Add(columnDefinition);
            }
        }

        var sql = $"CREATE TABLE {tableName} (\n  {string.Join(",\n  ", columns)}\n);";
        return sql;
    }

    private string GenerateColumnDefinition(PropertyInfo property, ColumnAttribute columnAttr)
    {
        var columnName = columnAttr.Name ?? property.Name;
        var dataType = columnAttr.DataType ?? GetSqlDataType(property.PropertyType);

        var definition = $"{columnName} {dataType}";

        if (columnAttr.IsIdentity)
        {
            definition += " IDENTITY(1,1)";
        }

        if (columnAttr.IsPrimaryKey)
        {
            definition += " PRIMARY KEY";
        }

        if (columnAttr.IsRequired)
        {
            definition += " NOT NULL";
        }

        return definition;
    }

    private string GetSqlDataType(Type propertyType)
    {
        // Nullable型の処理
        if (propertyType.IsGenericType && propertyType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
        {
            propertyType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(propertyType);
        }

        return propertyType.Name switch
        {
            nameof(Int32) => "INT",
            nameof(Int64) => "BIGINT",
            nameof(String) => "NVARCHAR(255)",
            nameof(DateTime) => "DATETIME2",
            nameof(Decimal) => "DECIMAL(18,2)",
            nameof(Boolean) => "BIT",
            nameof(Guid) => "UNIQUEIDENTIFIER",
            _ => "NVARCHAR(255)"
        };
    }

    public string GenerateSelectSQL<T>(object id = null)
    {
        var type = typeof(T);
        var tableAttr = type.GetCustomAttribute<TableAttribute>();
        var tableName = $"{tableAttr.Schema}.{tableAttr.Name}";

        var columns = GetColumnNames(type);
        var sql = $"SELECT {string.Join(", ", columns)} FROM {tableName}";

        if (id != null)
        {
            var primaryKeyColumn = GetPrimaryKeyColumn(type);
            sql += $" WHERE {primaryKeyColumn} = @Id";
        }

        return sql;
    }

    public string GenerateInsertSQL<T>()
    {
        var type = typeof(T);
        var tableAttr = type.GetCustomAttribute<TableAttribute>();
        var tableName = $"{tableAttr.Schema}.{tableAttr.Name}";

        var insertColumns = new List<string>();
        var valueParameters = new List<string>();

        foreach (var property in type.GetProperties())
        {
            var columnAttr = property.GetCustomAttribute<ColumnAttribute>();
            if (columnAttr != null && !columnAttr.IsIdentity)
            {
                insertColumns.Add(columnAttr.Name ?? property.Name);
                valueParameters.Add($"@{property.Name}");
            }
        }

        return $"INSERT INTO {tableName} ({string.Join(", ", insertColumns)}) " +
               $"VALUES ({string.Join(", ", valueParameters)})";
    }

    private List<string> GetColumnNames(Type type)
    {
        return type.GetProperties()
            .Where(p => p.GetCustomAttribute<ColumnAttribute>() != null)
            .Select(p => p.GetCustomAttribute<ColumnAttribute>().Name ?? p.Name)
            .ToList();
    }

    private string GetPrimaryKeyColumn(Type type)
    {
        var primaryKeyProperty = type.GetProperties()
            .FirstOrDefault(p => p.GetCustomAttribute<ColumnAttribute>()?.IsPrimaryKey == true);

        if (primaryKeyProperty == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{type.Name}にプライマリキーが定義されていません");

        var columnAttr = primaryKeyProperty.GetCustomAttribute<ColumnAttribute>();
        return columnAttr.Name ?? primaryKeyProperty.Name;
    }

    public void GenerateEntityDocumentation<T>()
    {
        var type = typeof(T);
        var tableAttr = type.GetCustomAttribute<TableAttribute>();

        Console.WriteLine($"\n=== エンティティ: {type.Name} ===");
        Console.WriteLine($"テーブル: {tableAttr?.Schema}.{tableAttr?.Name}");
        Console.WriteLine("\nカラム情報:");

        foreach (var property in type.GetProperties())
        {
            var columnAttr = property.GetCustomAttribute<ColumnAttribute>();
            if (columnAttr != null)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"  {property.Name}:");
                Console.WriteLine($"    カラム名: {columnAttr.Name ?? property.Name}");
                Console.WriteLine($"    データ型: {columnAttr.DataType ?? GetSqlDataType(property.PropertyType)}");
                Console.WriteLine($"    プライマリキー: {columnAttr.IsPrimaryKey}");
                Console.WriteLine($"    自動採番: {columnAttr.IsIdentity}");
                Console.WriteLine($"    必須: {columnAttr.IsRequired}");

                if (columnAttr.MaxLength > 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"    最大長: {columnAttr.MaxLength}");
                }
                Console.WriteLine();
            }
        }
    }
}

docs.text:
public class ReflectionPerformanceOptimizer
{
    // キャッシュによる最適化
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, PropertyInfo[]> _propertyCache = new();
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, MethodInfo[]> _methodCache = new();
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Delegate> _compiledAccessors = new();

    public void DemonstrateOptimizations()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("=== リフレクション最適化技法 ===");

        // 1. キャッシュの効果
        DemonstrateCaching();

        // 2. 式木コンパイルの効果
        DemonstrateExpressionCompilation();

        // 3. 最適化手法の比較
        ComparePerformance();
    }

    private void DemonstrateCaching()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n--- キャッシュ最適化 ---");

        const int iterations = 10000;
        var employee = new Employee("テスト", "部署");

        // キャッシュなし
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++)
        {
            var properties = typeof(Employee).GetProperties(); // 毎回取得
        }
        sw.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"キャッシュなし: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");

        // キャッシュあり
        sw.Restart();
        for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++)
        {
            var properties = GetCachedProperties(typeof(Employee));
        }
        sw.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"キャッシュあり: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");
    }

    private PropertyInfo[] GetCachedProperties(Type type)
    {
        return _propertyCache.GetOrAdd(type, t => t.GetProperties());
    }

    private void DemonstrateExpressionCompilation()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n--- 式木コンパイル最適化 ---");

        const int iterations = 100000;
        var employee = new Employee("テスト", "部署");
        var nameProperty = typeof(Employee).GetProperty("Name");

        // 通常のリフレクション
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++)
        {
            var value = nameProperty.GetValue(employee);
        }
        sw.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"リフレクション: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");

        // コンパイル済みアクセサー
        var getter = CreatePropertyGetter<Employee, string>("Name");
        sw.Restart();
        for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++)
        {
            var value = getter(employee);
        }
        sw.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"コンパイル済み: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");

        // 直接アクセス（参考）
        sw.Restart();
        for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++)
        {
            var value = employee.Name;
        }
        sw.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine($"直接アクセス: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");
    }

    private Func<T, TProperty> CreatePropertyGetter<T, TProperty>(string propertyName)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"{typeof(T).FullName}.{propertyName}.Get";

        return (Func<T, TProperty>)_compiledAccessors.GetOrAdd(cacheKey, _ =>
        {
            var parameter = Expression.Parameter(typeof(T), "obj");
            var property = Expression.Property(parameter, propertyName);
            var lambda = Expression.Lambda<Func<T, TProperty>>(property, parameter);
            return lambda.Compile();
        });
    }

    private void ComparePerformance()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n--- 総合パフォーマンス比較 ---");

        var testCases = new[]
        {
            ("プロパティ取得", (Action)(() => TestPropertyGetting())),
            ("メソッド呼び出し", (Action)(() => TestMethodInvocation())),
            ("オブジェクト生成", (Action)(() => TestObjectCreation()))
        };

        foreach (var (name, action) in testCases)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"\n{name}:");
            MeasurePerformance(action);
        }
    }

    private void TestPropertyGetting()
    {
        var employee = new Employee("テスト", "部署");
        var property = typeof(Employee).GetProperty("Name");

        // 複数回のプロパティアクセス
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            var value = property.GetValue(employee);
        }
    }

    private void TestMethodInvocation()
    {
        var employee = new Employee("テスト", "部署");
        var method = typeof(Employee).GetMethod("GetEmployeeInfo");

        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            var result = method.Invoke(employee, null);
        }
    }

    private void TestObjectCreation()
    {
        var constructor = typeof(Employee).GetConstructor(new[] { typeof(string), typeof(string) });

        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            var instance = constructor.Invoke(new object[] { "テスト", "部署" });
        }
    }

    private void MeasurePerformance(Action action)
    {
        // ウォームアップ
        action();

        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        action();
        sw.Stop();

        Console.WriteLine($"実行時間: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");
    }
}

docs.title: セキュリティ考慮事項
docs.text:
public class ReflectionSecurityManager
{
    // 許可されたアセンブリのリスト
    private readonly HashSet<string> _allowedAssemblies;

    // 許可されたメソッドのパターン
    private readonly HashSet<string> _allowedMethodPatterns;

    // 禁止されたタイプ
    private readonly HashSet<Type> _forbiddenTypes;

    public ReflectionSecurityManager()
    {
        _allowedAssemblies = new HashSet<string>
        {
            "System.Private.CoreLib",
            "MyApplication", // 自分のアプリケーション
            "MyApplication.Domain"
        };

        _allowedMethodPatterns = new HashSet<string>
        {
            "Get*",
            "Set*",
            "ToString",
            "Equals",
            "GetHashCode"
        };

        _forbiddenTypes = new HashSet<Type>
        {
            typeof(System.IO.File),
            typeof(System.Diagnostics.Process),
            typeof(System.Reflection.Assembly)
        };
    }

    public void DemonstrateSecurityChecks()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("=== リフレクションセキュリティチェック ===");

        // 安全なタイプアクセス
        TestSafeTypeAccess();

        // 危険なメソッド呼び出しの防止
        TestDangerousMethodPrevention();

        // アセンブリ制限
        TestAssemblyRestriction();
    }

    private void TestSafeTypeAccess()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n--- 安全なタイプアクセス ---");

        var safeType = typeof(Employee);
        var dangerousType = typeof(System.IO.File);

        Console.WriteLine($"Employee型のアクセス: {IsTypeAccessAllowed(safeType)}");
        Console.WriteLine($"File型のアクセス: {IsTypeAccessAllowed(dangerousType)}");
    }

    private void TestDangerousMethodPrevention()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n--- 危険なメソッド呼び出しの防止 ---");

        try
        {
            // 安全なメソッド
            InvokeMethodSafely(typeof(Employee), "GetEmployeeInfo", new Employee("テスト", "部署"), null);

            // 危険なメソッド（実際には呼び出されない）
            InvokeMethodSafely(typeof(System.IO.File), "Delete", null, new object[] { "somefile.txt" });
        }
        catch (SecurityException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"セキュリティ例外: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private void TestAssemblyRestriction()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n--- アセンブリ制限 ---");

        var currentAssembly = typeof(Employee).Assembly;
        var systemAssembly = typeof(string).Assembly;

        Console.WriteLine($"アプリケーションアセンブリ: {IsAssemblyAllowed(currentAssembly)}");
        Console.WriteLine($"システムアセンブリ: {IsAssemblyAllowed(systemAssembly)}");
    }

    public bool IsTypeAccessAllowed(Type type)
    {
        // 禁止タイプのチェック
        if (_forbiddenTypes.Contains(type))
        {
            return false;
        }

        // アセンブリのチェック
        if (!IsAssemblyAllowed(type.Assembly))
        {
            return false;
        }

        // 危険な名前空間のチェック
        var dangerousNamespaces = new[]
        {
            "System.IO",
            "System.Diagnostics",
            "System.Net",
            "System.Security"
        };

        if (dangerousNamespaces.Any(ns => type.Namespace?.StartsWith(ns) == true))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public bool IsAssemblyAllowed(Assembly assembly)
    {
        var assemblyName = assembly.GetName().Name;

        // 許可リストにあるか確認
        if (_allowedAssemblies.Contains(assemblyName))
        {
            return true;
        }

        // アプリケーション固有のアセンブリは許可
        if (assemblyName?.StartsWith("MyApplication") == true)
        {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public object InvokeMethodSafely(Type type, string methodName, object instance, object[] parameters)
    {
        // タイプアクセスチェック
        if (!IsTypeAccessAllowed(type))
        {
            throw new SecurityException($"タイプ {type.Name} へのアクセスは許可されていません");
        }

        // メソッド名パターンチェック
        if (!IsMethodNameAllowed(methodName))
        {
            throw new SecurityException($"メソッド {methodName} の実行は許可されていません");
        }

        var method = type.GetMethod(methodName);
        if (method == null)
        {
            throw new MethodAccessException($"メソッド {methodName} が見つかりません");
        }

        // 追加のセキュリティチェック
        if (IsMethodDangerous(method))
        {
            throw new SecurityException($"危険なメソッド {methodName} の実行は禁止されています");
        }

        Console.WriteLine($"安全なメソッド実行: {type.Name}.{methodName}");
        return method.Invoke(instance, parameters);
    }

    private bool IsMethodNameAllowed(string methodName)
    {
        return _allowedMethodPatterns.Any(pattern =>
        {
            if (pattern.EndsWith("*"))
            {
                return methodName.StartsWith(pattern.TrimEnd('*'));
            }
            return methodName == pattern;
        });
    }

    private bool IsMethodDangerous(MethodInfo method)
    {
        var dangerousMethodNames = new[]
        {
            "Delete",
            "Execute",
            "Start",
            "Kill",
            "Load",
            "LoadFrom"
        };

        return dangerousMethodNames.Contains(method.Name);
    }

    // 入力検証とサニタイズ
    public string SanitizeInput(string input)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input))
            return input;

        // 危険な文字の除去
        var dangerousChars = new[] { ';', '\'', '"', '<', '>', '&' };
        foreach (var ch in dangerousChars)
        {
            input = input.Replace(ch.ToString(), "");
        }

        return input;
    }

    // プロパティアクセスの制限
    public object GetPropertySafely(Type type, string propertyName, object instance)
    {
        if (!IsTypeAccessAllowed(type))
        {
            throw new SecurityException($"タイプ {type.Name} へのアクセスは許可されていません");
        }

        propertyName = SanitizeInput(propertyName);

        var property = type.GetProperty(propertyName);
        if (property == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException($"プロパティ {propertyName} が見つかりません");
        }

        if (!property.CanRead)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"プロパティ {propertyName} は読み取り専用ではありません");
        }

        return property.GetValue(instance);
    }
}

docs.text:
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Linq;

public class AdvancedConcurrentCollections
{
    // 高性能キャッシュシステムの実装
    public class HighPerformanceCache<TKey, TValue>
    {
        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, CacheItem<TValue>> _cache = new();
        private readonly TimeSpan _defaultExpiry;

        public HighPerformanceCache(TimeSpan defaultExpiry)
        {
            _defaultExpiry = defaultExpiry;
        }

        public async Task<TValue> GetOrAddAsync<TFactory>(TKey key, Func<TKey, Task<TValue>> factory)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            // 既存アイテムのチェック（期限も考慮）
            if (_cache.TryGetValue(key, out var existingItem) && !existingItem.IsExpired(now))
            {
                existingItem.UpdateLastAccess(now);
                return existingItem.Value;
            }

            // 新しいアイテムの作成または更新
            var newValue = await factory(key);
            var newItem = new CacheItem<TValue>(newValue, now, _defaultExpiry);

            _cache.AddOrUpdate(key, newItem, (k, oldItem) => 
                oldItem.IsExpired(now) ? newItem : oldItem);

            return newValue;
        }

        public void RemoveExpired()
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var expiredKeys = _cache
                .Where(kvp => kvp.Value.IsExpired(now))
                .Select(kvp => kvp.Key)
                .ToList();

            foreach (var key in expiredKeys)
            {
                _cache.TryRemove(key, out _);
            }
        }

        public CacheStatistics GetStatistics()
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var items = _cache.Values.ToList();

            return new CacheStatistics
            {
                TotalItems = items.Count,
                ExpiredItems = items.Count(item => item.IsExpired(now)),
                AverageAge = items.Any() ? 
                    TimeSpan.FromTicks((long)items.Average(item => (now - item.CreatedAt).Ticks)) : 
                    TimeSpan.Zero
            };
        }
    }

    public class CacheItem<T>
    {
        public T Value { get; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; }
        public DateTime ExpiresAt { get; }
        public DateTime LastAccessedAt { get; private set; }

        public CacheItem(T value, DateTime createdAt, TimeSpan ttl)
        {
            Value = value;
            CreatedAt = createdAt;
            ExpiresAt = createdAt.Add(ttl);
            LastAccessedAt = createdAt;
        }

        public bool IsExpired(DateTime now) => now > ExpiresAt;

        public void UpdateLastAccess(DateTime now) => LastAccessedAt = now;
    }

    public class CacheStatistics
    {
        public int TotalItems { get; set; }
        public int ExpiredItems { get; set; }
        public TimeSpan AverageAge { get; set; }
    }
}

public class MessageProcessingSystem<T>
{
    private readonly ConcurrentQueue<MessageEnvelope<T>> _messageQueue = new();
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, TaskCompletionSource<bool>> _pendingMessages = new();
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _processingLock;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _cancellationTokenSource = new();

    public MessageProcessingSystem(int maxConcurrency = Environment.ProcessorCount)
    {
        _processingLock = new SemaphoreSlim(maxConcurrency, maxConcurrency);
        StartBackgroundProcessing();
    }

    public async Task<bool> SendMessageAsync(T message, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
    {
        var messageId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        var envelope = new MessageEnvelope<T>(messageId, message);
        var tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();

        _pendingMessages[messageId] = tcs;
        _messageQueue.Enqueue(envelope);

        try
        {
            var timeoutTask = timeout.HasValue 
                ? Task.Delay(timeout.Value, _cancellationTokenSource.Token)
                : Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, _cancellationTokenSource.Token);

            var completedTask = await Task.WhenAny(tcs.Task, timeoutTask);

            if (completedTask == timeoutTask)
            {
                _pendingMessages.TryRemove(messageId, out _);
                return false; // タイムアウト
            }

            return await tcs.Task;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void StartBackgroundProcessing()
    {
        Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            while (!_cancellationTokenSource.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                if (_messageQueue.TryDequeue(out var envelope))
                {
                    _ = Task.Run(async () =>
                    {
                        await _processingLock.WaitAsync(_cancellationTokenSource.Token);
                        try
                        {
                            await ProcessMessageAsync(envelope);
                        }
                        finally
                        {
                            _processingLock.Release();
                        }
                    }, _cancellationTokenSource.Token);
                }
                else
                {
                    await Task.Delay(10, _cancellationTokenSource.Token);
                }
            }
        }, _cancellationTokenSource.Token);
    }

    private async Task ProcessMessageAsync(MessageEnvelope<T> envelope)
    {
        try
        {
            // メッセージ処理のシミュレート
            await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(50, 200), _cancellationTokenSource.Token);

            Console.WriteLine($"メッセージ処理完了: {envelope.MessageId}");

            if (_pendingMessages.TryRemove(envelope.MessageId, out var tcs))
            {
                tcs.SetResult(true);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"メッセージ処理エラー: {envelope.MessageId} - {ex.Message}");

            if (_pendingMessages.TryRemove(envelope.MessageId, out var tcs))
            {
                tcs.SetException(ex);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _cancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
        _processingLock?.Dispose();
        _cancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
    }
}

public class MessageEnvelope<T>
{
    public string MessageId { get; }
    public T Message { get; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; }

    public MessageEnvelope(string messageId, T message)
    {
        MessageId = messageId;
        Message = message;
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

技法の目的
docs.text: 複数のタスク間での精密な協調制御を実現し、効率的なリソース管理とワークフロー制御を提供します。

docs.title: Barrier を使用した段階的処理
docs.text:
public class PipelineProcessingSystem
{
    private readonly Barrier _stageBarrier;
    private readonly int _workerCount;
    private readonly List<WorkItem> _workItems;

    public PipelineProcessingSystem(int workerCount, List<WorkItem> workItems)
    {
        _workerCount = workerCount;
        _workItems = workItems;

        // バリアで段階的処理を同期
        _stageBarrier = new Barrier(workerCount, barrier =>
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"--- ステージ {barrier.CurrentPhaseNumber + 1} 完了 ---");
            Console.WriteLine($"すべてのワーカーが同期点に到達しました");
        });
    }

    public async Task ProcessAsync()
    {
        var tasks = Enumerable.Range(0, _workerCount).Select(workerId =>
            Task.Run(() => WorkerProcessAsync(workerId))).ToArray();

        await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        _stageBarrier.Dispose();
    }

    private async Task WorkerProcessAsync(int workerId)
    {
        // ステージ1: 初期化
        await ProcessStage1(workerId);
        _stageBarrier.SignalAndWait(); // 全ワーカーの完了を待機

        // ステージ2: メイン処理
        await ProcessStage2(workerId);
        _stageBarrier.SignalAndWait();

        // ステージ3: ファイナライズ
        await ProcessStage3(workerId);
        _stageBarrier.SignalAndWait();
    }

    private async Task ProcessStage1(int workerId)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: 初期化開始");
        await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(500, 1000));
        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: 初期化完了");
    }

    private async Task ProcessStage2(int workerId)
    {
        var itemsPerWorker = _workItems.Count / _workerCount;
        var startIndex = workerId * itemsPerWorker;
        var endIndex = workerId == _workerCount - 1 ? _workItems.Count : startIndex + itemsPerWorker;

        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: アイテム {startIndex}-{endIndex-1} を処理中");

        for (int i = startIndex; i < endIndex; i++)
        {
            await ProcessWorkItem(_workItems[i]);
        }

        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: メイン処理完了");
    }

    private async Task ProcessStage3(int workerId)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: ファイナライズ開始");
        await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(200, 500));
        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: ファイナライズ完了");
    }

    private async Task ProcessWorkItem(WorkItem item)
    {
        await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(50, 150));
        item.ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

docs.title: ManualResetEventSlim による細かい制御
docs.text:
public class ResourceCoordinationSystem
{
    private readonly ManualResetEventSlim _initializationComplete = new(false);
    private readonly ManualResetEventSlim _processingGate = new(false);
    private readonly CountdownEvent _workerCompletion;
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _resourceSemaphore;

    public ResourceCoordinationSystem(int workerCount, int maxResources)
    {
        _workerCompletion = new CountdownEvent(workerCount);
        _resourceSemaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(maxResources, maxResources);
    }

    public async Task RunCoordinatedWorkflowAsync(int workerCount)
    {
        // 初期化フェーズ
        var initTask = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            Console.WriteLine("システム初期化中...");
            await Task.Delay(2000); // 重い初期化処理をシミュレート
            Console.WriteLine("システム初期化完了");
            _initializationComplete.Set();
        });

        // ワーカータスクの開始
        var workerTasks = Enumerable.Range(0, workerCount)
            .Select(workerId => Task.Run(() => CoordinatedWorkerAsync(workerId)))
            .ToArray();

        // 初期化完了後、処理開始を許可
        await initTask;
        await Task.Delay(1000); // 準備時間
        Console.WriteLine("全ワーカーに処理開始を通知");
        _processingGate.Set();

        // 全ワーカーの完了を待機
        await Task.Run(() => _workerCompletion.Wait());
        Console.WriteLine("全ワーカーが完了しました");

        await Task.WhenAll(workerTasks);

        // リソースクリーンアップ
        _initializationComplete.Dispose();
        _processingGate.Dispose();
        _workerCompletion.Dispose();
        _resourceSemaphore.Dispose();
    }

    private async Task CoordinatedWorkerAsync(int workerId)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: 初期化完了を待機中...");
        await Task.Run(() => _initializationComplete.Wait());

        Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: 処理開始許可を待機中...");
        await Task.Run(() => _processingGate.Wait());

        try
        {
            // リソース取得
            await _resourceSemaphore.WaitAsync();

            try
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: リソース取得、作業開始");
                await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(1000, 3000));
                Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: 作業完了");
            }
            finally
            {
                _resourceSemaphore.Release();
                Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: リソース解放");
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _workerCompletion.Signal();
            Console.WriteLine($"Worker {workerId}: 完了通知");
        }
    }
}

docs.title: 3. Producer-Consumer パターン - Channelの活用
技法の目的
docs.text: 高性能な非同期データ処理パイプラインを構築し、背圧制御と効率的なメモリ使用を実現します。

docs.title: 高性能ストリーミング処理システム
docs.text:
using System.Threading.Channels;

public class StreamingDataProcessor<TInput, TOutput>
{
    private readonly ChannelWriter<TInput> _inputWriter;
    private readonly ChannelReader<TInput> _inputReader;
    private readonly ChannelWriter<TOutput> _outputWriter;
    private readonly ChannelReader<TOutput> _outputReader;

    private readonly Func<TInput, Task<TOutput>> _processor;
    private readonly int _parallelism;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _cancellationTokenSource = new();

    public ChannelReader<TOutput> OutputReader => _outputReader;

    public StreamingDataProcessor(
        Func<TInput, Task<TOutput>> processor,
        int capacity = 1000,
        int parallelism = Environment.ProcessorCount)
    {
        _processor = processor;
        _parallelism = parallelism;

        // バックプレッシャー対応の入力チャネル
        var inputChannel = Channel.CreateBounded<TInput>(new BoundedChannelOptions(capacity)
        {
            FullMode = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait,
            SingleReader = false,
            SingleWriter = false
        });

        _inputWriter = inputChannel.Writer;
        _inputReader = inputChannel.Reader;

        // 出力チャネル
        var outputChannel = Channel.CreateUnbounded<TOutput>();
        _outputWriter = outputChannel.Writer;
        _outputReader = outputChannel.Reader;

        StartProcessingPipeline();
    }

    public async Task<bool> SendAsync(TInput input, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            using var linkedCts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(
                cancellationToken, _cancellationTokenSource.Token);

            return await _inputWriter.WriteAsync(input, linkedCts.Token);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void StartProcessingPipeline()
    {
        // 複数のプロセッサータスクを起動
        for (int i = 0; i < _parallelism; i++)
        {
            _ = Task.Run(ProcessorWorkerAsync, _cancellationTokenSource.Token);
        }
    }

    private async Task ProcessorWorkerAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await foreach (var input in _inputReader.ReadAllAsync(_cancellationTokenSource.Token))
            {
                try
                {
                    var output = await _processor(input);
                    await _outputWriter.WriteAsync(output, _cancellationTokenSource.Token);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"処理エラー: {ex.Message}");
                    // エラーハンドリング - 必要に応じてエラーを出力チャネルに送信
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // 期待される例外
        }
    }

    public async Task CompleteAsync()
    {
        _inputWriter.Complete();

        // 入力処理の完了を待機
        await foreach (var _ in _inputReader.ReadAllAsync())
        {
            // 残りのアイテムを消費
        }

        _outputWriter.Complete();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _cancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
        _inputWriter.TryComplete();
        _outputWriter.TryComplete();
        _cancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
    }
}

// 使用例：画像処理パイプライン
public class ImageProcessingExample
{
    public async Task ProcessImagesAsync(IEnumerable<string> imagePaths)
    {
        var processor = new StreamingDataProcessor<string, ProcessedImage>(
            ProcessImageAsync,
            capacity: 100,
            parallelism: 4
        );

        // 画像の送信
        var sendTask = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            foreach (var imagePath in imagePaths)
            {
                await processor.SendAsync(imagePath);
            }
            await processor.CompleteAsync();
        });

        // 処理結果の受信
        var results = new List<ProcessedImage>();
        await foreach (var result in processor.OutputReader.ReadAllAsync())
        {
            results.Add(result);
            Console.WriteLine($"画像処理完了: {result.FileName}");
        }

        await sendTask;
        processor.Dispose();

        Console.WriteLine($"総処理画像数: {results.Count}");
    }

    private async Task<ProcessedImage> ProcessImageAsync(string imagePath)
    {
        // 画像処理のシミュレート
        await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(100, 500));

        return new ProcessedImage
        {
            FileName = Path.GetFileName(imagePath),
            ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            SizeBytes = new FileInfo(imagePath).Length
        };
    }
}

public class ProcessedImage
{
    public string FileName { get; set; }
    public DateTime ProcessedAt { get; set; }
    public long SizeBytes { get; set; }
}

public class AdvancedAsyncPatterns
{
    // ConfigureAwait(false) による性能最適化
    public async Task<List<ApiResponse>> FetchMultipleResourcesAsync(List<string> urls)
    {
        using var httpClient = new HttpClient();

        var tasks = urls.Select(async url =>
        {
            try
            {
                // ConfigureAwait(false) でコンテキストキャプチャを回避
                var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(url).ConfigureAwait(false);
                var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);

                return new ApiResponse
                {
                    Url = url,
                    StatusCode = (int)response.StatusCode,
                    Content = content,
                    CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return new ApiResponse
                {
                    Url = url,
                    StatusCode = -1,
                    Content = ex.Message,
                    CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                };
            }
        });

        return (await Task.WhenAll(tasks).ConfigureAwait(false)).ToList();
    }

    // ValueTask による効率的な戻り値
    public ValueTask<CacheResult<T>> GetFromCacheAsync<T>(string key)
    {
        if (_memoryCache.TryGetValue(key, out var cachedValue))
        {
            // 同期的に値が取得できる場合は ValueTask を直接返す
            return ValueTask.FromResult(new CacheResult<T>
            {
                Value = (T)cachedValue,
                IsHit = true,
                Source = "Memory"
            });
        }

        // 非同期処理が必要な場合のみ Task を作成
        return new ValueTask<CacheResult<T>>(FetchFromRemoteCacheAsync<T>(key));
    }

    private async Task<CacheResult<T>> FetchFromRemoteCacheAsync<T>(string key)
    {
        await Task.Delay(100).ConfigureAwait(false); // リモートアクセスをシミュレート

        return new CacheResult<T>
        {
            Value = default(T),
            IsHit = false,
            Source = "Remote"
        };
    }

    private readonly MemoryCache _memoryCache = new();
}

// IAsyncEnumerable による効率的なストリーミング
public class AsyncEnumerablePatterns
{
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<BatchResult> ProcessLargeBatchAsync(
        IEnumerable<WorkItem> items,
        int batchSize = 100,
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var batch = new List<WorkItem>(batchSize);
        var batchNumber = 0;

        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            batch.Add(item);

            if (batch.Count == batchSize)
            {
                yield return await ProcessBatchAsync(batch, batchNumber++, cancellationToken);
                batch.Clear();
            }
        }

        // 残りのアイテムを処理
        if (batch.Count > 0)
        {
            yield return await ProcessBatchAsync(batch, batchNumber, cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private async Task<BatchResult> ProcessBatchAsync(
        List<WorkItem> batch, 
        int batchNumber, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var startTime = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // バッチ処理のシミュレート
        await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(100, 500), cancellationToken);

        return new BatchResult
        {
            BatchNumber = batchNumber,
            ItemCount = batch.Count,
            ProcessingTime = DateTime.UtcNow - startTime,
            ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
    }

    // 使用例
    public async Task RunLargeBatchProcessingAsync()
    {
        var items = Enumerable.Range(0, 10000)
            .Select(i => new WorkItem { Id = i, Data = $"Item {i}" })
            .ToList();

        await foreach (var batchResult in ProcessLargeBatchAsync(items, batchSize: 250))
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"バッチ {batchResult.BatchNumber}: " +
                            $"{batchResult.ItemCount} 件処理完了 " +
                            $"({batchResult.ProcessingTime.TotalMilliseconds:F0}ms)");
        }
    }
}

docs.title: 5. 並行処理の診断と最適化 - パフォーマンス測定とトラブルシューティング
技法の目的
docs.text: 並行処理の性能問題を特定し、デッドロックやレースコンディションを防止する実践的な技法を提供します。

docs.title: パフォーマンス測定フレームワーク
docs.text:
using System.Diagnostics;

public class ConcurrencyPerformanceAnalyzer
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, PerformanceMetrics> _metrics = new();
    private readonly object _metricsLock = new object();

    public async Task<T> MeasureAsync<T>(string operationName, Func<Task<T>> operation)
    {
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var startMemory = GC.GetTotalMemory(false);
        var startTime = DateTime.UtcNow;

        try
        {
            var result = await operation();

            stopwatch.Stop();
            var endMemory = GC.GetTotalMemory(false);

            RecordMetrics(operationName, stopwatch.Elapsed, endMemory - startMemory, true);

            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            stopwatch.Stop();
            RecordMetrics(operationName, stopwatch.Elapsed, 0, false);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private void RecordMetrics(string operationName, TimeSpan duration, long memoryDelta, bool success)
    {
        lock (_metricsLock)
        {
            if (!_metrics.TryGetValue(operationName, out var metrics))
            {
                metrics = new PerformanceMetrics(operationName);
                _metrics[operationName] = metrics;
            }

            metrics.RecordExecution(duration, memoryDelta, success);
        }
    }

    public ConcurrencyReport GenerateReport()
    {
        lock (_metricsLock)
        {
            return new ConcurrencyReport
            {
                GeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                Operations = _metrics.Values.ToList(),
                SystemInfo = GetSystemInfo()
            };
        }
    }

    private SystemInfo GetSystemInfo()
    {
        return new SystemInfo
        {
            ProcessorCount = Environment.ProcessorCount,
            WorkerThreads = ThreadPool.ThreadCount,
            TotalMemory = GC.GetTotalMemory(false),
            Gen0Collections = GC.CollectionCount(0),
            Gen1Collections = GC.CollectionCount(1),
            Gen2Collections = GC.CollectionCount(2)
        };
    }
}

public class PerformanceMetrics
{
    public string OperationName { get; }
    public int TotalExecutions { get; private set; }
    public int SuccessfulExecutions { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan TotalDuration { get; private set; }
    public TimeSpan MinDuration { get; private set; } = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
    public TimeSpan MaxDuration { get; private set; }
    public long TotalMemoryAllocated { get; private set; }

    public PerformanceMetrics(string operationName)
    {
        OperationName = operationName;
    }

    public void RecordExecution(TimeSpan duration, long memoryDelta, bool success)
    {
        TotalExecutions++;
        if (success) SuccessfulExecutions++;

        TotalDuration = TotalDuration.Add(duration);
        if (duration < MinDuration) MinDuration = duration;
        if (duration > MaxDuration) MaxDuration = duration;

        if (memoryDelta > 0) TotalMemoryAllocated += memoryDelta;
    }

    public double SuccessRate => TotalExecutions > 0 ? (double)SuccessfulExecutions / TotalExecutions : 0;
    public TimeSpan AverageDuration => TotalExecutions > 0 ? 
        TimeSpan.FromTicks(TotalDuration.Ticks / TotalExecutions) : TimeSpan.Zero;
}

// デッドロック検出システム
public class DeadlockDetector
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<int, ThreadInfo> _threadStates = new();
    private readonly Timer _monitoringTimer;

    public event Action<DeadlockWarning> DeadlockDetected;

    public DeadlockDetector(TimeSpan checkInterval)
    {
        _monitoringTimer = new Timer(CheckForDeadlocks, null, checkInterval, checkInterval);
    }

    public IDisposable TrackLockAcquisition(object lockObject, string operationName)
    {
        var threadId = Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId;
        var threadInfo = new ThreadInfo
        {
            ThreadId = threadId,
            LockObject = lockObject,
            OperationName = operationName,
            WaitStartTime = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _threadStates[threadId] = threadInfo;

        return new LockTracker(() => _threadStates.TryRemove(threadId, out _));
    }

    private void CheckForDeadlocks(object state)
    {
        var currentTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var longWaitingThreads = _threadStates.Values
            .Where(info => currentTime - info.WaitStartTime > TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10))
            .ToList();

        if (longWaitingThreads.Count > 1)
        {
            var warning = new DeadlockWarning
            {
                DetectedAt = currentTime,
                SuspiciousThreads = longWaitingThreads,
                RecommendedAction = "長時間待機中のスレッドを確認してください"
            };

            DeadlockDetected?.Invoke(warning);
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _monitoringTimer?.Dispose();
    }
}

public class ThreadInfo
{
    public int ThreadId { get; set; }
    public object LockObject { get; set; }
    public string OperationName { get; set; }
    public DateTime WaitStartTime { get; set; }
}

public class LockTracker : IDisposable
{
    private readonly Action _onDispose;

    public LockTracker(Action onDispose)
    {
        _onDispose = onDispose;
    }

    public void Dispose() => _onDispose?.Invoke();
}

public class DeadlockWarning
{
    public DateTime DetectedAt { get; set; }
    public List<ThreadInfo> SuspiciousThreads { get; set; }
    public string RecommendedAction { get; set; }
}

docs.title: 実用的なベンチマークシステム
docs.text:
public class ConcurrencyBenchmark
{
    public async Task<BenchmarkResult> CompareConcurrencyApproachesAsync<T>(
        IEnumerable<T> data,
        Func<T, Task<object>> processor)
    {
        var dataList = data.ToList();
        var analyzer = new ConcurrencyPerformanceAnalyzer();

        // 1. 順次処理
        var sequentialResult = await analyzer.MeasureAsync("Sequential", async () =>
        {
            var results = new List<object>();
            foreach (var item in dataList)
            {
                results.Add(await processor(item));
            }
            return results;
        });

        // 2. Task.WhenAll による並行処理
        var parallelResult = await analyzer.MeasureAsync("Parallel", async () =>
        {
            var tasks = dataList.Select(processor);
            return await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        });

        // 3. Parallel.ForEach による並行処理
        var plinqResult = await analyzer.MeasureAsync("PLINQ", async () =>
        {
            var results = new ConcurrentBag<object>();
            await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                Parallel.ForEach(dataList, item =>
                {
                    var result = processor(item).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                    results.Add(result);
                });
            });
            return results.ToArray();
        });

        // 4. Channel ベースのストリーミング処理
        var streamingResult = await analyzer.MeasureAsync("Streaming", async () =>
        {
            var streamProcessor = new StreamingDataProcessor<T, object>(processor);
            var results = new List<object>();

            var sendTask = Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                foreach (var item in dataList)
                {
                    await streamProcessor.SendAsync(item);
                }
                await streamProcessor.CompleteAsync();
            });

            await foreach (var result in streamProcessor.OutputReader.ReadAllAsync())
            {
                results.Add(result);
            }

            await sendTask;
            streamProcessor.Dispose();
            return results;
        });

        return new BenchmarkResult
        {
            Report = analyzer.GenerateReport(),
            DataSize = dataList.Count,
            RecommendedApproach = DetermineRecommendedApproach(analyzer.GenerateReport())
        };
    }

    private string DetermineRecommendedApproach(ConcurrencyReport report)
    {
        var sortedByPerformance = report.Operations
            .OrderBy(op => op.AverageDuration)
            .ThenByDescending(op => op.SuccessRate)
            .ToList();

        return sortedByPerformance.First().OperationName;
    }
}

public static class PerformanceMeasurement
{
    public static async Task<(T result, TimeSpan duration, long memoryDelta)> 
        MeasureAsync<T>(Func<Task<T>> operation)
    {
        // メモリ測定の準備
        GC.Collect();
        GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();
        GC.Collect();

        var startMemory = GC.GetTotalMemory(false);
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

        var result = await operation();

        stopwatch.Stop();
        var endMemory = GC.GetTotalMemory(false);

        return (result, stopwatch.Elapsed, endMemory - startMemory);
    }

    public static void PrintThreadPoolStats()
    {
        ThreadPool.GetAvailableThreads(out var availableWorker, out var availableCompletion);
        ThreadPool.GetMaxThreads(out var maxWorker, out var maxCompletion);

        Console.WriteLine($"スレッドプール統計:");
        Console.WriteLine($"  ワーカースレッド: {maxWorker - availableWorker}/{maxWorker}");
        Console.WriteLine($"  完了ポートスレッド: {maxCompletion - availableCompletion}/{maxCompletion}");
    }
}

docs.text:
public class ConcurrencyBenchmarkExample
{
    public async Task RunComprehensiveBenchmarkAsync()
    {
        var testData = Enumerable.Range(0, 10000)
            .Select(i => new WorkItem { Id = i, Data = $"Item {i}" })
            .ToList();

        Console.WriteLine("=== 並行処理性能比較 ===\n");

        // 1. 順次処理
        await BenchmarkApproach("順次処理", testData, async items =>
        {
            var results = new List<string>();
            foreach (var item in items)
            {
                results.Add(await ProcessItemAsync(item));
            }
            return results;
        });

        // 2. Task.WhenAll
        await BenchmarkApproach("Task.WhenAll (制限なし)", testData, async items =>
        {
            var tasks = items.Select(ProcessItemAsync);
            return await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        });

        // 3. SemaphoreSlim による制限
        await BenchmarkApproach("SemaphoreSlim制限", testData, async items =>
        {
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(100);
            var tasks = items.Select(async item =>
            {
                await semaphore.WaitAsync();
                try
                {
                    return await ProcessItemAsync(item);
                }
                finally
                {
                    semaphore.Release();
                }
            });
            return await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        });

        // 4. Parallel.ForEach
        await BenchmarkApproach("Parallel.ForEach", testData, async items =>
        {
            var results = new ConcurrentBag<string>();
            await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                Parallel.ForEach(items, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = 100 }, 
                    item =>
                    {
                        var result = ProcessItemAsync(item).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                        results.Add(result);
                    });
            });
            return results.ToArray();
        });

        // 5. Channel ベース
        await BenchmarkApproach("Channel ストリーミング", testData, async items =>
        {
            var processor = new StreamingDataProcessor<WorkItem, string>(ProcessItemAsync);
            var results = new List<string>();

            var sendTask = Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                foreach (var item in items)
                {
                    await processor.SendAsync(item);
                }
                await processor.CompleteAsync();
            });

            await foreach (var result in processor.OutputReader.ReadAllAsync())
            {
                results.Add(result);
            }

            await sendTask;
            processor.Dispose();
            return results;
        });
    }

    private async Task BenchmarkApproach<T>(
        string approachName, 
        List<WorkItem> testData, 
        Func<List<WorkItem>, Task<T>> approach)
    {
        try
        {
            var (result, duration, memoryDelta) = await PerformanceMeasurement.MeasureAsync(
                () => approach(testData));

            Console.WriteLine($"{approachName}:");
            Console.WriteLine($"  実行時間: {duration.TotalMilliseconds:F0} ms");
            Console.WriteLine($"  メモリ増加: {memoryDelta:N0} bytes");
            Console.WriteLine($"  スループット: {testData.Count / duration.TotalSeconds:F0} items/sec");
            PerformanceMeasurement.PrintThreadPoolStats();
            Console.WriteLine();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{approachName}: エラー - {ex.Message}\n");
        }
    }

    private async Task<string> ProcessItemAsync(WorkItem item)
    {
        // 実際の処理をシミュレート
        await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(1, 10));
        return $"Processed: {item.Data}";
    }
}

// Domain/Entities/BaseEntity.cs
public abstract class BaseEntity : IEquatable<BaseEntity>
{
    public Guid Id { get; protected set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; protected set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime UpdatedAt { get; protected set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public string CreatedBy { get; protected set; }
    public string UpdatedBy { get; protected set; }

    // ドメインイベント（Observerパターン統合）
    private readonly List<IDomainEvent> _domainEvents = new();
    public IReadOnlyList<IDomainEvent> DomainEvents => _domainEvents.AsReadOnly();

    protected void AddDomainEvent(IDomainEvent domainEvent)
    {
        _domainEvents.Add(domainEvent);
    }

    public void ClearDomainEvents()
    {
        _domainEvents.Clear();
    }

    protected void UpdateTimestamp(string updatedBy = null)
    {
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedBy = updatedBy;
    }

    protected void SetCreatedBy(string createdBy)
    {
        CreatedBy = createdBy;
    }

    // エンティティ等価性の実装
    public bool Equals(BaseEntity other)
    {
        if (ReferenceEquals(null, other)) return false;
        if (ReferenceEquals(this, other)) return true;
        return Id.Equals(other.Id);
    }

    public override bool Equals(object obj) => Equals(obj as BaseEntity);
    public override int GetHashCode() => Id.GetHashCode();
}

// Domain/Entities/User.cs
public class User : BaseEntity
{
    public Email Email { get; private set; }
    public Name Name { get; private set; }
    public PasswordHash PasswordHash { get; private set; }
    public UserRole Role { get; private set; }
    public UserStatus Status { get; private set; } = UserStatus.Active;
    public UserPreferences Preferences { get; private set; }

    // ナビゲーションプロパティ
    private readonly List<TaskItem> _assignedTasks = new();
    public IReadOnlyList<TaskItem> AssignedTasks => _assignedTasks.AsReadOnly();

    private readonly List<Project> _ownedProjects = new();
    public IReadOnlyList<Project> OwnedProjects => _ownedProjects.AsReadOnly();

    // EF Core用のプライベートコンストラクタ
    protected User() { }

    // ファクトリーメソッドパターン
    public static User Create(string email, string name, string password, UserRole role = UserRole.Member)
    {
        var user = new User();
        user.SetEmail(email);
        user.SetName(name);
        user.SetPassword(password);
        user.Role = role;
        user.Preferences = UserPreferences.CreateDefault();

        // ドメインイベント発行
        user.AddDomainEvent(new UserCreatedEvent(user.Id, user.Email.Value, user.Name.FullName));

        return user;
    }

    public void SetEmail(string email)
    {
        var newEmail = Email.Create(email);
        if (Email?.Value != newEmail.Value)
        {
            Email = newEmail;
            UpdateTimestamp();
            AddDomainEvent(new UserEmailChangedEvent(Id, newEmail.Value));
        }
    }

    public void SetName(string firstName, string lastName)
    {
        Name = Name.Create(firstName, lastName);
        UpdateTimestamp();
    }

    public void SetPassword(string password)
    {
        PasswordHash = PasswordHash.Create(password);
        UpdateTimestamp();
        AddDomainEvent(new UserPasswordChangedEvent(Id));
    }

    public void ChangeRole(UserRole newRole, string changedBy)
    {
        if (Role != newRole)
        {
            var oldRole = Role;
            Role = newRole;
            UpdateTimestamp(changedBy);
            AddDomainEvent(new UserRoleChangedEvent(Id, oldRole, newRole));
        }
    }

    public void Deactivate(string reason = null)
    {
        Status = UserStatus.Inactive;
        UpdateTimestamp();
        AddDomainEvent(new UserDeactivatedEvent(Id, reason));
    }

    public void Activate()
    {
        Status = UserStatus.Active;
        UpdateTimestamp();
        AddDomainEvent(new UserActivatedEvent(Id));
    }

    // ビジネスルールの実装
    public bool CanManageProject(Project project)
    {
        return Role == UserRole.Admin || project.OwnerId == Id;
    }

    public bool CanAssignTask(TaskItem task, User assignee)
    {
        return Role == UserRole.Admin || 
               Role == UserRole.ProjectManager ||
               task.Project.OwnerId == Id;
    }
}

// Domain/ValueObjects/Email.cs
public class Email : ValueObject
{
    public string Value { get; private set; }

    private Email(string value)
    {
        Value = value;
    }

    public static Email Create(string email)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
            throw new DomainException("メールアドレスは必須です", "EMAIL_REQUIRED");

        email = email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        if (!IsValidEmail(email))
            throw new DomainException("無効なメールアドレス形式です", "EMAIL_INVALID_FORMAT");

        return new Email(email);
    }

    private static bool IsValidEmail(string email)
    {
        try
        {
            var addr = new System.Net.Mail.MailAddress(email);
            return addr.Address == email;
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    protected override IEnumerable<object> GetEqualityComponents()
    {
        yield return Value;
    }
}

// Domain/ValueObjects/Name.cs
public class Name : ValueObject
{
    public string FirstName { get; private set; }
    public string LastName { get; private set; }
    public string FullName => $"{FirstName} {LastName}".Trim();

        FirstName = firstName;

    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstName))
            throw new DomainException("名前は必須です", "NAME_FIRSTNAME_REQUIRED");

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lastName))
            throw new DomainException("姓は必須です", "NAME_LASTNAME_REQUIRED");

        return new Name(firstName.Trim(), lastName.Trim());
    }

    protected override IEnumerable<object> GetEqualityComponents()
    {
        yield return FirstName;
        yield return LastName;
    }
}

        task.SetTitle(title);
        task.SetDescription(description);
        task.AssignedUserId = assignedUserId;
        task.ProjectId = projectId;
        task.DueDate = dueDate;
        task.Priority = priority;
        task.EstimatedHours = EstimatedHours.Create(0);
        task.ActualHours = ActualHours.Create(0);

        task.AddDomainEvent(new TaskCreatedEvent(task.Id, task.Title.Value, assignedUserId, projectId));

        return task;
    }

    public void SetTitle(string title)
    {
        var newTitle = Title.Create(title);
        if (Title?.Value != newTitle.Value)
        {
            Title = newTitle;
            UpdateTimestamp();
            AddDomainEvent(new TaskTitleChangedEvent(Id, newTitle.Value));
        }
    }

    public void SetDescription(string description)
    {
        Description = Description.Create(description);
        UpdateTimestamp();
    }

    public void ChangeStatus(TaskStatus newStatus, string changedBy = null)
    {
        if (Status == newStatus) return;

        ValidateStatusTransition(Status, newStatus);

        var oldStatus = Status;
        Status = newStatus;
        UpdateTimestamp(changedBy);

        // ステータス変更時の特別な処理
        if (newStatus == TaskStatus.InProgress)
        {
            AddDomainEvent(new TaskStartedEvent(Id, AssignedUserId));
        }
        else if (newStatus == TaskStatus.Completed)
        {
            AddDomainEvent(new TaskCompletedEvent(Id, AssignedUserId, ActualHours.Value));
        }

        AddDomainEvent(new TaskStatusChangedEvent(Id, oldStatus, newStatus));
    }

    public void SetPriority(TaskPriority priority)
    {
        if (Priority != priority)
        {
            var oldPriority = Priority;
            Priority = priority;
            UpdateTimestamp();
            AddDomainEvent(new TaskPriorityChangedEvent(Id, oldPriority, priority));
        }
    }

    public void SetDueDate(DateTime? dueDate)
    {
        DueDate = dueDate;
        UpdateTimestamp();
        AddDomainEvent(new TaskDueDateChangedEvent(Id, dueDate));
    }

    public void AddComment(string content, Guid authorId)
    {
        var comment = TaskComment.Create(Id, content, authorId);
        _comments.Add(comment);
        UpdateTimestamp();
        AddDomainEvent(new TaskCommentAddedEvent(Id, comment.Id, authorId));
    }

    public void LogTimeSpent(decimal hours, string description = null)
    {
        ActualHours = ActualHours.Add(hours);
        UpdateTimestamp();
        AddDomainEvent(new TaskTimeLoggedEvent(Id, hours, description));
    }

    // ビジネスルールの実装
    public bool IsOverdue => DueDate.HasValue && DueDate.Value < DateTime.UtcNow && Status != TaskStatus.Completed;

    public bool CanChangeStatus(TaskStatus newStatus)
    {
        return IsValidStatusTransition(Status, newStatus);
    }

    private static void ValidateStatusTransition(TaskStatus currentStatus, TaskStatus newStatus)
    {
        if (!IsValidStatusTransition(currentStatus, newStatus))
        {
            throw new DomainException(
                $"無効なステータス遷移: {currentStatus} → {newStatus}", 
                "TASK_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION");
        }
    }

    private static bool IsValidStatusTransition(TaskStatus current, TaskStatus target)
    {
        return current switch
        {
            TaskStatus.Todo => target is TaskStatus.InProgress or TaskStatus.Cancelled,
            TaskStatus.InProgress => target is TaskStatus.Completed or TaskStatus.Todo or TaskStatus.Cancelled,
            TaskStatus.Completed => target is TaskStatus.InProgress,
            TaskStatus.Cancelled => target is TaskStatus.Todo,
            _ => false
        };
    }
}

// Infrastructure/Repositories/TaskRepository.cs
public class TaskRepository : ITaskRepository
{
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context;
    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
    private readonly IDistributedCache _distributedCache;
    private readonly ILogger<TaskRepository> _logger;
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _cacheSemaphore = new(1, 1);

    private static readonly TimeSpan CacheExpiry = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);
    private static readonly TimeSpan DistributedCacheExpiry = TimeSpan.FromHours(1);

    public TaskRepository(
        ApplicationDbContext context,
        IMemoryCache cache,
        IDistributedCache distributedCache,
        ILogger<TaskRepository> logger)
    {
        _context = context;
        _cache = cache;
        _distributedCache = distributedCache;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<TaskItem> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // L1キャッシュ（メモリ）チェック
        string memoryCacheKey = $"task:memory:{id}";
        if (_cache.TryGetValue(memoryCacheKey, out TaskItem cachedTask))
        {
            _logger.LogDebug("メモリキャッシュヒット: Task {TaskId}", id);
            return cachedTask;
        }

        // L2キャッシュ（分散）チェック
        string distributedCacheKey = $"task:distributed:{id}";
        var distributedCachedJson = await _distributedCache.GetStringAsync(distributedCacheKey, cancellationToken);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(distributedCachedJson))
        {
            try
            {
                var distributedCachedTask = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TaskItem>(distributedCachedJson);
                await CacheInMemoryAsync(memoryCacheKey, distributedCachedTask);
                _logger.LogDebug("分散キャッシュヒット: Task {TaskId}", id);
                return distributedCachedTask;
            }
            catch (JsonException ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(ex, "分散キャッシュデシリアライズ失敗: Task {TaskId}", id);
            }
        }

        // データベースから取得
        var task = await _context.Tasks
            .Include(t => t.AssignedUser)
            .Include(t => t.Project)
            .Include(t => t.Comments.OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedAt))
            .AsSplitQuery() // パフォーマンス最適化
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == id, cancellationToken);

        if (task != null)
        {
            // マルチレベルキャッシュに保存
            await CacheTaskAsync(memoryCacheKey, distributedCacheKey, task);
            _logger.LogDebug("データベースから取得: Task {TaskId}", id);
        }

        return task;
    }

    // LINQ高度活用：複雑な分析クエリ
    public async Task<TaskAnalyticsDto> GetTaskAnalyticsAsync(GetTaskAnalyticsQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var baseQuery = _context.Tasks.AsNoTracking();

        // 動的クエリ構築（LINQ + Strategy パターン）
        if (query.UserId.HasValue)
            baseQuery = baseQuery.Where(t => t.AssignedUserId == query.UserId.Value);

        if (query.ProjectId.HasValue)
            baseQuery = baseQuery.Where(t => t.ProjectId == query.ProjectId.Value);

        if (query.DateFrom.HasValue)
            baseQuery = baseQuery.Where(t => t.CreatedAt >= query.DateFrom.Value);

        if (query.DateTo.HasValue)
            baseQuery = baseQuery.Where(t => t.CreatedAt <= query.DateTo.Value);

        // 並列実行による高速化
        var analyticsTask = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            var tasks = await baseQuery.ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            return new TaskAnalyticsDto
            {
                TotalTasks = tasks.Count,
                CompletedTasks = tasks.Count(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed),
                OverdueTasks = tasks.Count(t => t.IsOverdue),
                TasksInProgress = tasks.Count(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.InProgress),
                CompletionRate = tasks.Count > 0 ? (double)tasks.Count(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed) / tasks.Count * 100 : 0,

                // LINQ グループ化による高度な分析
                TasksByPriority = tasks
                    .GroupBy(t => t.Priority)
                    .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),

                TasksByStatus = tasks
                    .GroupBy(t => t.Status)
                    .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),

                AverageCompletionTime = tasks
                    .Where(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed)
                    .Select(t => (t.UpdatedAt - t.CreatedAt).TotalDays)
                    .DefaultIfEmpty(0)
                    .Average(),

                ProductivityTrend = tasks
                    .Where(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed)
                    .GroupBy(t => t.UpdatedAt.Date)
                    .OrderBy(g => g.Key)
                    .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),

                TopPerformers = tasks
                    .Where(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed)
                    .GroupBy(t => t.AssignedUserId)
                    .Select(g => new UserPerformanceDto
                    {
                        UserId = g.Key,
                        CompletedTasksCount = g.Count(),
                        AverageTimeToComplete = g.Average(t => (t.UpdatedAt - t.CreatedAt).TotalDays)
                    })
                    .OrderByDescending(p => p.CompletedTasksCount)
                    .Take(10)
                    .ToList()
            };
        }, cancellationToken);

        return await analyticsTask;
    }

    // バッチ処理用の効率的なメソッド（並行処理活用）
    public async Task<IEnumerable<TaskItem>> GetTasksBatchAsync(IEnumerable<Guid> taskIds, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var taskIdList = taskIds.ToList();
        const int batchSize = 100;

        // 大量のIDを分割して並列処理
        var batches = taskIdList
            .Select((id, index) => new { id, index })
            .GroupBy(x => x.index / batchSize)
            .Select(g => g.Select(x => x.id).ToList());

        var tasks = new List<TaskItem>();

        await Parallel.ForEachAsync(batches, 
            new ParallelOptions { CancellationToken = cancellationToken, MaxDegreeOfParallelism = 4 },
            async (batch, ct) =>
            {
                var batchTasks = await _context.Tasks
                    .Where(t => batch.Contains(t.Id))
                    .Include(t => t.AssignedUser)
                    .Include(t => t.Project)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                lock (tasks)
                {
                    tasks.AddRange(batchTasks);
                }
            });

        return tasks;
    }

    private async Task CacheTaskAsync(string memoryCacheKey, string distributedCacheKey, TaskItem task)
    {
        await _cacheSemaphore.WaitAsync();
        try
        {
            // メモリキャッシュ
            _cache.Set(memoryCacheKey, task, CacheExpiry);

            // 分散キャッシュ
            var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(task);
            await _distributedCache.SetStringAsync(distributedCacheKey, json, new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = DistributedCacheExpiry
            });
        }
        finally
        {
            _cacheSemaphore.Release();
        }
    }

    private async Task CacheInMemoryAsync(string cacheKey, TaskItem task)
    {
        await _cacheSemaphore.WaitAsync();
        try
        {
            _cache.Set(cacheKey, task, CacheExpiry);
        }
        finally
        {
            _cacheSemaphore.Release();
        }
    }
}

// Infrastructure/UnitOfWork/IUnitOfWork.cs
public interface IUnitOfWork : IDisposable
{
    ITaskRepository Tasks { get; }
    IUserRepository Users { get; }
    IProjectRepository Projects { get; }

    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<IDbContextTransaction> BeginTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task CommitTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task RollbackTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

// Infrastructure/UnitOfWork/UnitOfWork.cs
public class UnitOfWork : IUnitOfWork
{
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context;
    private readonly IDomainEventDispatcher _domainEventDispatcher;
    private IDbContextTransaction _currentTransaction;

    public ITaskRepository Tasks { get; }
    public IUserRepository Users { get; }
    public IProjectRepository Projects { get; }

    public UnitOfWork(
        ApplicationDbContext context,
        ITaskRepository taskRepository,
        IUserRepository userRepository,
        IProjectRepository projectRepository,
        IDomainEventDispatcher domainEventDispatcher)
    {
        _context = context;
        _domainEventDispatcher = domainEventDispatcher;
        Tasks = taskRepository;
        Users = userRepository;
        Projects = projectRepository;
    }

    public async Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // ドメインイベントの収集（Observerパターン）
        var domainEvents = _context.ChangeTracker
            .Entries<BaseEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Entity.DomainEvents.Any())
            .SelectMany(x => x.Entity.DomainEvents)
            .ToList();

        try
        {
            var result = await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            // ドメインイベントの発行
            foreach (var domainEvent in domainEvents)
            {
                await _domainEventDispatcher.DispatchAsync(domainEvent, cancellationToken);
            }

            // イベント履歴のクリア
            _context.ChangeTracker
                .Entries<BaseEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Entity.DomainEvents.Any())
                .ToList()
                .ForEach(entity => entity.Entity.ClearDomainEvents());

            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // エラー時はロールバック
            if (_currentTransaction != null)
            {
                await RollbackTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<IDbContextTransaction> BeginTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        _currentTransaction = await _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
        return _currentTransaction;
    }

    public async Task CommitTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (_currentTransaction == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("アクティブなトランザクションがありません");

        try
        {
            await _currentTransaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
        }
        finally
        {
            await _currentTransaction.DisposeAsync();
            _currentTransaction = null;
        }
    }

    public async Task RollbackTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (_currentTransaction == null) return;

        try
        {
            await _currentTransaction.RollbackAsync(cancellationToken);
        }
        finally
        {
            await _currentTransaction.DisposeAsync();
            _currentTransaction = null;
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _currentTransaction?.Dispose();
        _context.Dispose();
    }
}
